title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers that everyday reality is a simulation and joins rebels fighting the machines that control humanity.

title: Inception
description: A thief who enters dreams assembles a team to plant an idea inside a powerful heir while struggling with memories of his wife.

title: Interstellar
description: As Earth becomes uninhabitable, astronauts travel through a wormhole to seek a new home while a father hopes to reunite with his daughter.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded on Mars uses engineering and botany to survive while colleagues on Earth organize a rescue.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist studies the language of alien visitors to understand their intentions as nations struggle to cooperate.

title: Alien
description: The crew of a commercial spaceship encounters a deadly alien organism that hunts them in confined corridors.

title: Jurassic Park
description: Visitors to a theme park of cloned dinosaurs fight to survive when its security systems fail.

title: Jaws
description: A police chief, a marine scientist, and a fisherman hunt a shark terrorizing a seaside community.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A cautious clownfish crosses the ocean with a forgetful companion to rescue his son from a dentist aquarium.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy toy grows jealous of a new space ranger toy, but the rivals must cooperate to return to their owner.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl works in a mysterious bathhouse for spirits while trying to free her parents and return to the human world.

title: Ratatouille
description: A rat with a talent for cooking teams up with a young kitchen worker to pursue fine cuisine in Paris.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A hotel concierge and his young lobby boy become entangled in an inheritance dispute and the theft of a valuable painting.

title: Groundhog Day
description: A cynical television weatherman repeatedly relives the same day in a small town and gradually changes how he treats others.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Two acquaintances encounter each other over many years and question whether friendship can remain separate from romantic attraction.

title: Titanic
description: A wealthy young woman and a poor artist fall in love aboard an ocean liner before its disastrous collision with an iceberg.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker imprisoned for murder forms a lasting friendship and sustains hope through decades of confinement and corruption.

title: The Godfather
description: The reluctant son of a powerful crime family becomes increasingly involved in its violent struggles for power.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman confronts a criminal who spreads chaos through Gotham and tests the moral limits of its defenders.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit and a fellowship set out to destroy a powerful ring before a dark ruler can reclaim it.
